runs.failure_point: It named the right matter and opening date, but described the subject without the shelf-eligibility qualifier a criterion requires.

first_error.why: The answer describes the latest matter as a universal shelf registration on Form S-3 but omits that it is the automatic (well-known seasoned issuer) shelf, which the memorandum and engagement letter it read state (evidence seen at [74]-[78]); no review named the omission.

divergence: All three runs found the client's ten matters, read the latest matter's new-matter memorandum and engagement letter, and named the right matter and opening date. They split only at the write stage: T0 and T1 described the subject with its full shelf-registration qualifier and passed, while T2 described it as a universal shelf registration on Form S-3 without the eligibility qualifier a criterion requires. No review in T2 named the omission; its reviews of the write and check stages questioned the opening-date source and the coverage of other matters.
